📖 How to use

  1. Click "Start recording" and allow microphone access.
  2. Speak — the live timer shows elapsed time.
  3. Click "Stop recording".
  4. Play back your recording below, then download it as a .webm file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I record?

Click "Start recording" and allow microphone access when the browser asks. The timer shows the recording length; click "Stop" to finish.

What format is the download?

The download uses WebM (usually Opus audio), the most widely supported format for browser recording. It plays in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and most media players.

Why do I get a microphone error?

The browser blocks microphone access without permission, on insecure pages, or when no mic is present. Serve the page over HTTPS (or localhost) and check your system mic settings.

Is my recording uploaded anywhere?

No. Recording and encoding happen entirely in your browser; audio never leaves your device.
